# Subway Seat for Warp

Background, text, accent, cursor and the 16 ANSI colours. On Linux the themes folder is `~/.local/share/warp-terminal/themes/`; on Windows, `%APPDATA%\warp\Warp\data\themes\`.

[Warp](https://www.warp.dev) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/warp/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.yaml`](subway-seat.yaml) | ~/.warp/themes/subway-seat.yaml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.yaml`](subway-seat-tunnel.yaml) | ~/.warp/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.yaml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.yaml`](subway-seat-enamel.yaml) | ~/.warp/themes/subway-seat-enamel.yaml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
cp subway-seat.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat in the theme picker
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
cp subway-seat-tunnel.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat Tunnel in the theme picker
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Warp › Settings › Appearance › Themes:

```sh
cp subway-seat-enamel.yaml ~/.warp/themes/   # then pick Subway Seat Enamel in the theme picker
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
